issues.description: The problem statement names the exercise 'H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon' (problem_statement.md) but the template and solution repositories use different project names in settings.gradle ('H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' and 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution'). This mismatch of the exercise/project identifier across artifacts can create unnecessary confusion for students about which exercise they are working on and where to find related resources.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exercise/project identifier consistent across artifacts. For example, set rootProject.name in both template and solution settings.gradle files to match the problem statement (e.g., 'H02E02---Panic-at-Seal-Saloon'), or update the problem statement title to match the existing project names. Ensure the same identifier is used in any README or metadata to avoid student confusion.
